revisions.text: Your motivations are pedestrian, but the gusto with which you pursue them is nothing short of inspiring.
Grace, in the past, ambition has driven you to greatness. Today, it will enshrine you in legend.
Great, in the past, ambition has driven you to greatness. Today, it will enshrine you in legend.
